one_line: East India Company civil servant who documented Kerala mathematical texts and their infinite series in the early 19th century.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, medium height, slightly bookish but healthy build
appearance.face: Oval face with fair English complexion, straight nose, light brown eyes, subtle sideburns, a few faint ink smudges on fingers, default expression calm and observant with a slight analytical focus
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed dark brown hair with a side part; modest early-19th-century English style; no hat, but a folded dark navy gentleman’s top hat tucked under his arm as part of his props
appearance.costume: Early 19th-century East India Company civilian attire: a well-fitted dark navy tailcoat with simple brass buttons over a cream high-collared linen shirt and a soft light blue cravat, a slightly tapered tan waistcoat, and straight beige cotton trousers tucked neatly into polished black leather shoes; a thin dark brown leather belt, and a simple pocket watch chain barely visible at his waist; the cut and fabric are modest but clearly those of a literate Company official posted in South India.
appearance.signature: A worn leather-bound notebook held open in his left hand with a quill pen in his right, pages showing faint geometric diagrams and series notations inspired by Kerala shastras, plus a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with red string tucked under his arm beside the folded top hat.

ref_desc: Charles Matthew Whish is a fair-complexioned English man in a dark navy tailcoat, cream shirt and light blue cravat, with short neat dark brown hair, holding a leather notebook and quill plus a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, in a beige-and-tan outfit with black shoes.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Charles Matthew Whish: a late-20s English civil servant standing upright, fair complexion, oval face, calm analytical expression, short neatly combed dark brown hair with a side part, light brown eyes. He wears an early 19th-century dark navy tailcoat with simple brass buttons over a cream high-collared linen shirt, a light blue cravat, and a tan waistcoat, with straight beige cotton trousers and polished black leather shoes, plus a thin dark brown belt and a subtle pocket watch chain at his waist. His signature props are a worn leather-bound notebook held open in his left hand with faint geometric diagrams and series-like markings, a quill pen in his right hand poised to write, and a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with red string tucked under his arm beside a folded dark navy top hat. Use a navy, cream, beige, tan, and black palette, and show him front-facing, side, and back views so the face, hair, outfit, and signature items are clear and consistent.
